???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is one symbol of text as a person would count it, such as a letter or `λ`, called?"

        A character. Some characters fit in one byte; others need several.

        Introduced in [1. Source text and error messages](stage-1-source-and-diagnostics.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a message from the compiler about a problem in the source?"

        A diagnostic. In v0.1 every diagnostic is an error and carries a source location.

        Introduced in [1. Source text and error messages](stage-1-source-and-diagnostics.md). Specification: [10. Diagnostics](../../specification/diagnostics.md#101-required-diagnostic-data).

    ??? question "What is the file of Vortex text handed to the compiler called?"

        The source file, a sequence of source characters provided to the compiler.

        Introduced in [1. Source text and error messages](stage-1-source-and-diagnostics.md). Specification: [1. Conformance and terminology](../../specification/conformance.md#12-programs).

    ??? question "What do we call a value written directly in the source, such as `42` or `true`?"

        A literal. Integer, floating-point, boolean, character and string literals are the scalar forms.

        Introduced in [Learn: 5. Expressions](../../language-tour/08-expressions.md). Specification: [2. Lexical structure](../../specification/lexical-structure.md#25-literals).

    ??? question "Inside a string or character literal, what do we call `\n` or `\t`?"

        An escape sequence, a backslash and a character that stand for something hard to type. v0.1 supports `\n`, `\t`, `\\`, `\"` and `\'`.

        Introduced in [Learn: 2. Basic source rules](../../language-tour/02-basic-source-rules.md). Specification: [2. Lexical structure](../../specification/lexical-structure.md#character-and-string-literals).
